props.title: DARKXSIDE: why mesh, why now (placeholder audio — final clip pending)
props.speaker: DARKXSIDE
props.transcript: So the question I keep getting is why bother with mesh when 5G exists. The answer is simple: 5G is not a right, it's a subscription. When the cell tower goes down in St. Maarten, the block goes dark. When the mesh node goes down, the block fixes it.

props.quote: We started with five families and a question. Eight weeks later, 23 households are on the lattice and the block votes on its own infrastructure.
